departure.survival_reference: causally known evolving VWAP zone; exact contact, gap-through, reference overtake, window/anchor change, or contract change ends the episode
departure.rearm: a later mature completed close inside the departure threshold after termination; no same-bar rearm
departure.already_away_policy: exclude from elapsed-since-departure analyses because the true departure time is unobserved

question_a.primary: contact checkpoint-frozen VWAP zone within 30 elapsed minutes
secondary: contact checkpoint-frozen VWAP zone by observation-window end
contact causally evolving VWAP over both deadlines
question_a.reference_movement_metric: evolving contact within 30 minutes without frozen checkpoint-VWAP contact
question_a.future_begins: one-minute bar opening at forecast available_at

question_b.return_destination: checkpoint VWAP rounded half-up to instrument tick, plus/minus one tick
question_b.extension_rounding: ceiling whole ticks away from checkpoint close
question_b.gap_policy: an opening gap beyond a destination resolves that destination first and is separately flagged; both destinations in one one-minute range are ambiguous

question_c.crossing: published completed-close cross through local-session VWAP, with close strictly between rounded one-tick day/session zones
question_c.selection_reason: at least four ticks of interior space remain after both one-tick zones; 15,078 primary events, 2,962 product-sessions, and at least 953 events in every product/session cell before outcomes
question_c.primary_destinations: event-time frozen rounded day and session VWAP zones
question_c.updated_population: original frozen-target race still unresolved at the checkpoint; deadline remains event time plus 30 minutes

rounding: reference centers use half-up tick rounding; extension distance uses ceiling ticks

models.type: development-only Dirichlet-smoothed supported conditional estimator with hierarchical backoff
models.score: one-half multiclass Brier sum; binary form equals ordinary Brier score

uncertainty.unit: shared ISO week across products, anchors, timeframes, episodes, and checkpoints

complete_day_eligibility: retrospective sample selection, not a live feature
